name: lassocut
description: Remove image backgrounds from Claude with your LassoCut account.
long_description: Ask Claude to cut out product photos, portraits or whole folders. Results are saved next to your originals. Previews by default (50 free per month); full size only when you ask, and above 10 full-size images Claude must show the cost and get your OK first. The API is compatible with the remove.bg API.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background of images (files, folders or URLs)

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Connect a LassoCut account in the browser

api_key.title: LassoCut API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty and ask Claude to sign in, or paste a key from https://www.lassocut.com/account/
